comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rail onto a rack; record releases a screwdriver from a spring clamp and transfers it to a marked pose.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate depresses a tab while inserting paired prongs, supports and extends a long rail, then fastens screws; record opens a clamp and establishes an opposed fingertip grasp on a tool.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks full multi-post mechanical installation; record checks clamp clearance, tool pose, loaded fingertip contacts, fixture stability, and a 1 s hold.
comparison.reason: A shared spring interaction is generic; the record does not test staged structural latching or rack registration. Candidate force limits and precise prong tolerances are missing.
